294|3887a5a0.name: Marshal Haggard
294|3887a5a0.text: Hail, traveler.  My eyesight may be poor but I can sense the footsteps of a $c from a mile away.  For years I defended Stormwind with pride but once my eyes failed me, I was forced to retire.

4456|0be64368.name: Fiora Longears
4456|0be64368.text: No, Longears isn't my real name.  And I'm not going to tell you what it is, so don't ask.

101-progress.name: Madame Eva
101-progress.text: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-progress.title: The Totem of Infliction

115-progress.name: Marshal Marris
115-progress.text: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters?  Did you find the midnight orbs?
115-progress.title: Shadow Magic

1241-progress.name: Jorgen
1241-progress.text: Hmph, you better have good reason to interrupt a man and his fishin'. I don't take kindly to peddlers, let alone beggars.
1241-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1242-progress.name: Elling Trias
1242-progress.text: Hello, $N. Is there something I can do for you? Perhaps you'd like to try some of our special Trias cheddar? Or a block of Darnassian bleu?
1242-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1243-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1243-progress.text:
Not too safe to be traveling about in the woods, $N. Be careful, and if you see anything suspicious or dangerous, contact the Watchers immediately. Don't try and take anything on yourself. We're not responsible for anything terrible that might happen to you.

But we both know you're gonna ignore me and fight whatever comes out of the darkness anyway, don't we? Haha, yeah, you adventurer types... all the same.
1243-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1244-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1244-progress.text: Be careful out there, $N. I know Trias was the one to send you here, but that doesn't mean there isn't anything lurking out in the woods that couldn't cause you some trouble... especially with you investigating the Defias.
1244-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1245-progress.name: Elling Trias
1245-progress.text: I see you're back, and in one piece. We both know you're not here for cheese, so let's cut out the pleasantries. Was Backus any help, or have you even left for Duskwood yet?
1245-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1246-accept.name: Elling Trias
1246-accept.text:
Yeah, now that I think about it... Dashel... Dashel something... What was his name? FIST! Dashel Stonefist. They call him Fist in some circles--probably on account that he likes to get in brawls.

You can find him in $N Town usually--right smack dab in the center of it. Go talk to him. If you have to, use a sword or something heavy and blunt to persuade him to open up some. And don't hesitate. If he's in this as deep as these papers suggest, then he's not going to give you any information willingly.
1246-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1250-accept.name: Tapoke "Slim" Jahn
1250-accept.text:
The Defias didn't pay me well enough to die for their cause. They took the king. Yeah, the king of Stormwind, not some lowly diplomat. He was on his way to Theramore to meet with Jaina Proudmoore--it was a big deal apparently, and a big secret. But it's not just the Defias that are involved. They're working with someone. I think they knew this was bigger than them.

My part was just to get their man on board the king's ship while it was moored. The guy's name was Hendel. That's all I know. I swear!
1250-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

126-progress.name: Verner Osgood
126-progress.text: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N.  If you're not ready for him, I understand.
126-progress.title: Howling in the Hills

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

133-progress.name: Abercrombie
133-progress.text: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick!  Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?
133-progress.title: Ghoulish Effigy

134-progress.name: Abercrombie
134-progress.text: Do you have my crate?  If so, then please...give it to me quickly!
134-progress.title: Ogre Thieves

135-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
135-accept.text: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons.  Perhaps that was a slip of tongue.  Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons?  Only one man would know for sure:  Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in $N Town.
135-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1442-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
1442-progress.text: I would be less trustful of one not on a holy path if they came asking about a Kor gem. But I trust your kind more than some of my kin. I do not judge your entire order based on the actions of just one of your fallen kind.
1442-progress.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
149-progress.title: Ghost Hair Thread

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

156-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-progress.text: Hi, $N.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
156-progress.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

157-progress.name: Abercrombie
157-progress.text: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
157-progress.title: Deliver the Thread

159-progress.name: Abercrombie
159-progress.text: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights.  Did you get it for me?
159-progress.title: Juice Delivery

160-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
160-progress.text:
Abercrombie...?  I don't know a person of that name.  You say you have a letter for me from this Abercrombie fellow?

Well let's have it then...
160-progress.title: Note to the Mayor

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

1654-progress.name: Jordan Stilwell
1654-progress.text:
The items you're seeking will be difficult to acquire, but I can assure you, the weapon I will craft for you will be worth the effort.

It will be my finest work to date, and only a small payment for the service you've done me.
1654-progress.title: The Test of Righteousness

1655-progress.name: Bailor Stonehand
1655-progress.text: So, any luck yet? Haha, those ogres didn't get the best of ya yet, did they?
1655-progress.title: Bailor's Ore Shipment

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

167-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-progress.text: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
167-progress.title: Oh Brother...

168-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
168-progress.title: Collecting Memories

174-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-progress.text: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
174-progress.title: Look to the Stars

177-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
177-progress.text: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine.  He was impressed.  Did you happen to find a reflective device?
177-progress.title: Look to the Stars

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

181-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
181-progress.text: Were you able to convince Zzarc'Vul to lend us his monocle for our experiment?
181-progress.title: Look to the Stars

19-progress.name: Marshal Marris
19-progress.text: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense.  But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
19-progress.title: Tharil'zun

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

214-progress.name: Scout Riell
214-progress.text: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang?  If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
214-progress.title: Red Silk Bandanas

223-progress.name: Jonathan Carevin
223-progress.text: Yes, what is it? Make it quick, I've pressing matters to attend to.
223-progress.title: Worgen in the Woods

230-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
230-progress.text: You found what??  Please, let me see it...
230-progress.title: Sven's Camp

240-progress.name: Jitters
240-progress.text: $N, you're here!  Do you have my food?!?
240-progress.title: Return to Jitters

251-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
251-progress.text: A note from Abercrombie the hermit, eh?  I don't know him, though if he lives out at the graveyard then I do know his brains have rotted out!
251-progress.title: Translate Abercrombie's Note

252-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
252-progress.text: Ah, is the note translated?  Please, let me see it...
252-progress.title: Translation to Ello

253-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
253-progress.text: Have you yet found Eliza's grave?  Do you have the Embalmer's heart?
253-progress.title: Bride of the Embalmer

262-progress.name: Madame Eva
262-progress.text: If you have something that belongs to the shadowy figure for whom you seek, then let me see it.  I may be able to divine something of its owner.
262-progress.title: The Shadowy Figure

265-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
265-progress.text:
Sometimes I'll sell blank books to scholars and mages, or to anyone who wants to keep a journal.

I remember well everyone to whom I sold a book within the last few months...
265-progress.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

266-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-progress.text:
The Scarlet Raven doesn't see the business it used to, but we still do get travelers passing through.

If you can describe the person you're looking for, maybe I'll remember him.
266-progress.title: Inquire at the Inn

268-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
268-progress.text: Did you find who the Shadowy Figure was?
268-progress.title: Return to Sven

269-progress.name: Bishop Farthing
269-progress.text: Rest, brother.  I can tell you have traveled far, and you bear a heavy burden.  Can you tell me what casts that dark shadow over you?
269-progress.title: Seeking Wisdom

2746-progress.name: Tyrion
2746-progress.text:
I've been watching Lescovar for a couple weeks now. Trias has never trusted him, but we didn't suspect he was involved in anything to do with the Defias Brotherhood. We were following leads that tied him to the Twilight's Hammer. Either way, he's become more dangerous than this city can deal with, and that's where we come in.

Get me those items and we can put my plan into effect.
2746-progress.title: Items of Some Consequence

322-progress.name: Grimand Elmore
322-progress.text: How might I ply my craft for you, $c?
322-progress.title: Blessed Arm

324-progress.name: Glorin Steelbrow
324-progress.text: Did you find the lightforge iron you need?
324-progress.title: The Lost Ingots

325-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
325-progress.text: Hello, $N.  You haven't been gone that long, but I see a fire in your eyes I did not see before.
325-progress.title: Armed and Ready

337-progress.name: Milton Sheaf
337-progress.text: Ooh!  What's that old book you have there?  Can I see it??
337-progress.title: An Old History Book

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

377-progress.name: Councilman Millstipe
377-progress.text: So long as a molester of the dead like Dextren Ward is permitted to live, justice stands betrayed.  Return to me once Lord Ebonlocke's sentence of death is carried out on that defiler, Ward.  We shall give the families of the dead the closure they deserve and better yet, we will send a clear message to the House of Nobles in Stormwind.
377-progress.title: Crime and Punishment

386-progress.name: Guard Berton
386-progress.text: Have you been to Stormwind yet, to The Stockade?  I fear whatever trickery that has kept Targorr the Dread alive for this long will eventually bring about his freedom.  He was sentenced to die, $N, not act as some political pawn on a noble's whim.
386-progress.title: What Comes Around...

388-progress.name: Nikova Raskol
388-progress.text: I see you are back, $c.  Have you collected 10 Red Wool Bandanas from those Defias Scum in The Stockade yet?
388-progress.title: The Color of Blood

391-progress.name: Warden Thelwater
391-progress.text: Either you bring me Thredd's head, or I'll take yours, understand, $N?
391-progress.title: The Stockade Riots

393-accept.name: Baros Alexston
393-accept.text:
I really haven't a clue, $N. There is someone else who might be able to help you, and it so happens that he owes me a favor for--well, let's not get into that. Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7 can be found in the barracks in $N Town. Shaw has his thumb on most of the shady, or underhanded dealings of the city.

If anyone knows, it'd be him.
393-accept.title: Shadow of the Past

393-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
393-progress.text: Greetings. Of what service can I be to you, $c?
393-progress.title: Shadow of the Past

394-accept.name: Elling Trias
394-accept.text:
Find Shaw in $N Town. Let him know that the Lescovar threat has been dealt with and about your involvement in the Lord's plots against the city. I'm sure he'll be proud to have another hero among Stormwind's citizens.

He'll more than likely send you off to meet with the Prince or some other noble. Don't let it get to your head, $N. The nobles can think they rule the city all they want, but some things remain out of their hands.
394-accept.title: The Head of the Beast

396-progress.name: Lady Katrana Prestor
396-progress.text: $N, yes? I was informed by Baros Alexston that you would be coming. I must say, I am most interested in what you have to say.
396-progress.title: An Audience with the King

453-progress.name: Jitters
453-progress.text: Who are you??  Leave me be!
453-progress.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

469-progress.name: James Halloran
469-progress.text: Hello there, $c. Could I interest you in a pair of boots?  Perhaps some newly cured skins?
469-progress.title: Daily Delivery

68-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
68-progress.text: Ah, I remember you.  You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow.  Did you ever find what you were looking for?
68-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

70-progress.name: Caretaker Folsom
70-progress.text: What have ya got there?  Let me take a look at that. . .
70-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

74-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
74-progress.text: What have you got there?  I cannot see.  My eyesight is very bad.  Put it in my hands.
74-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

75-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
75-progress.text: Did you find that page I mentioned, $N?
75-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

78-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
78-progress.text:
Marshal Haggard sent you?  Why didn't you say so? 

Ah, good ol' Haggard.  Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long.  Anyway, let me see what you've got there.
78-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

78142-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78142-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78142-progress.title: Bewitchments and Glamours

78147-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78147-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78147-progress.title: Crimes Against Anatomy

78148-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78148-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78148-progress.title: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings

79-progress.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
79-progress.text: This better be good, $c.  Let me see what you have and tell me your tale.  But by the Light, be quick about it.  Darkshire's defense is my number one priority.  I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
79-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

80-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
80-progress.text: Back again, $N?  What do you have this time?
80-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

90-progress.name: Chef Grual
90-progress.text: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet?
90-progress.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

91904-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91905-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91905-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91905-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91905-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91905-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91905-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

96137-accept.name: Unknown
96137-accept.text:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.
96137-accept.title: Ira's Dagger

96137-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96137-complete.text:
Ira? Are you sure? Sounds like the woman was damn near a ghost before she died. I'm surprised you found her.

Rest assured I will take great care of this dagger.
96137-complete.title: Ira's Dagger

96139-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-progress.text: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139-progress.title: The Valor Family

97894-complete.name: Gorbold Steelhand
97894-complete.text:
$N Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.

We could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.
97894-complete.title: Business in Auberdine

98071-accept.name: Brewmeister Bilger
98071-accept.text:
Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. 

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
98071-accept.title: Brewer's Trade

98197-accept.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-accept.text:
This harbor was first built by the $N Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197-accept.title: Spoils of War

98463-accept.name: Barkeep Kelly
98463-accept.text:
Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.

The real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.

Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.

Nixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.
98463-accept.title: Talk of the Town
